title: Keep backend health probe cheap
summary: Keep the public backend health route as a cheap liveness and startup-progress probe by excluding long-run reliability counters from /api/health.
reason: The Tauri lifecycle monitor polls /api/health with a short timeout. Computing runtime reliability evidence there can enumerate large ActiveJobs state and make an otherwise live backend appear unhealthy.
behavior_before: /api/health could include long-run reliability counters and block while reading runtime evidence such as ActiveJobs records.
behavior_after: /api/health returns backend health and startup progress only; runtime reliability counters remain available through authenticated snapshot and diagnostics routes.
tests_added: Updated LocalApiHttpTests.test_local_api_health_is_public_and_snapshot_requires_token to assert /api/health omits long_run_reliability while /api/snapshot still exposes the counters.

rollback_plan: Restore runtime_reliability_counters in the health payload and revert the corresponding HTTP test assertion.
notes:
Keep public backend health liveness payload cheap by leaving runtime reliability counters off /api/health.
Assert /api/health omits runtime reliability counters while snapshot remains the read route for those counters.
